info.description: Run in order against an Admin development server. No tokens or role headers. Default main4000 Sales server is read-only for Customers; use a separately configured Admin server4102. Preserve the idempotency key when retrying. GET /api/v1 alone has no route.

request.description: Orders > Customers. Sales/manager/viewer can read within team scope.

exec: if (data && data.addresses) for (const a of data.addresses) {if(a.label==='Warehouse A')pm.collectionVariables.set('warehouseAId',a.id);if(a.label==='Warehouse B')pm.collectionVariables.set('warehouseBId',a.id);}
